address: 1F, Shangri La Hotel, 472 Wenchang West Road, Hanjiang, Yangzhou, China Mainland
bio: This hotel restaurant originally served Cantonese fare but later switched to Huaiyang cuisine. Just like its counterparts around the world, the well-appointed room is done out in modern Chinese style. The kitchen is helmed by a formally trained young chef, who expresses his creative take on Huaiyang traditions in his new three heads: mugwort lion's head pork balls, pig's head terrine with finger lime and fermented sour soup with deboned fish head....
